Name: Sympathetic
Description: If foe initiates combat and if unit’s HP is 50% or less, unit takes 5 less damage.

Name: Deadly Blade
Description: If unit initiates combat with a sword, grants Crit+10 during combat.

Name: Battlewise
Description: Grants a stacking Crit+1 each time unit initiates combat and defeats a foe. Bonus lasts for the rest of the battle. (Max +10)

Name: Renewal
Description: Unit recovers 5 HP each turn.

Name: Windsweep
Description: If unit initiates combat with a sword, foe may not counterattack. Trigger %=Lck.

Name: Great Thunder
Description: If unit uses Thunder, Elthunder, or Thoron, deals +20% damage.

Name: Bane
Description: May reduce foe’s HP to 1. Trigger %=half of Dex. (Certain foes are immune to this effect.)

Name: Mercy
Description: If dealing enough damage to defeat foe, instead leaves foe with 1 HP.

Name: Raging Fire
Description: If unit uses Fire, Elfire, or Bolganone, deals +20% damage.

Name: Strong Arm
Description: Grants Hit+20 while unit is equipped with a smash weapon.

Name: Miracle
Description: Avoids foe’s attack when unit would be defeated. Trigger %=Lck. (Max 50%)

Name: Dire Thunder
Description: When unit initiates combat with Thunder equipped, unit attacks twice. (Excludes Elthunder and Thoron.)

Name: Rightful Ruler
Description: Adds +5% to trigger rate for all skills with trigger rates.

Name: Healtouch
Description: When unit heals an ally with a staff, restores +5 HP to target.

Name: Draw Back
Description: Use to move 1 space away from adjacent ally and pull the ally along.

Name: Giga Excalibur
Description: If unit initiates combat with Excalibur, deals +20% damage.

Name: Wind Adept
Description: If unit initiates combat with Wind equipped, unit may attack twice. Trigger %=Dex. (Excludes Elwind and Excalibur.)

Name: Shove
Description: Use to push an adjacent ally with less Bld 1 space away.

Name: Flickering Flower
Description: If unit initiates combat, freezes foe. Trigger % = total damage dealt.

Name: Paraselene
Description: Use to make an attack against an adjacent foe, then move 1 space away from that foe after combat.

Name: Wind God
Description: If unit’s HP=100%, grants range +1 with bows.

Name: Chivalry
Description: If unit initiates combat while foe’s HP=100%, unit deals +2 damage and takes 2 less damage.

Name: Bushido
Description: If unit’s level is higher than foe’s, grants Crit+10 during combat, and unit deals +2 damage and takes 2 less damage.

Name: Lethality
Description: When landing a critical hit, instantly kills foe. Trigger %=30. (Excludes certain powerful foes.)

Name: Sure Strike
Description: If unit initiates combat, attacks are guaranteed to hit. Trigger %=Dex

Name: Spur Attack
Description: Grants Atk+2 to adjacent allies.

Name: Fortify Def
Description: Grants Def+2 to adjacent allies for 1 turn at start of player phase.

Name: Spur Res
Description: Grants Res+2 to adjacent allies.
